title: Harmonic morphisms of sub-Riemannian Lie groups
summary: We prove that harmonic morphisms between sub-Riemannian Lie groups are smooth, are symmetries of the sub-Riemannian Laplacian and are conformal submersions that satisfy a particular PDE. Moreover, we give some partial results for harmonic morphisms beyond Lie groups. We show the existence of harmonic coordinates for harmonically homogeneous spaces, and that smooth harmonic morphisms are symmetries of the Laplacian in all sub-Riemannian manifolds.
